title: Expert Binding Tracking — Master 建议 + Performer 实际 + Review 复盘
description:
EPIC-157 — ticket.json schema 加 4 字段跟踪 expert binding, 让 mis_dispatch_rate 真正可测.

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-02 review 决定 — Master 拆卡时给 `suggested_expert`, Performer 领卡时 binding `actual_expert` + `expert_binding_at`, 偏离时 `binding_change_reason` 必填. 等任务完成, 通过 `phase-review` 复盘一致率, 通过 `sprint-metrics` 暴露 mis_dispatch_rate (<10% 阈值).

**设计 (跟 BE-14 + EPIC-054-A + EPIC-023-C 联合, 0 冲突)**:
1. `suggested_expert` — Master 拆卡时填, 枚举: 4 default + 5 extended + extended pool (15 local). 可选, 留空 = 不建议
2. `actual_expert` — Performer claim 时填, 必填. Performer 可覆盖 Master 建议
3. `expert_binding_at` — ISO8601 timestamp, `/kallax-claim` 时戳
4. `binding_change_reason` — 当 actual != suggested 时, 必填非空文本 (治根: Performer 不能 silent 改 expert)

**北极星打通**: EPIC-023-C mis_dispatch_rate 之前缺数据源, 加这 4 字段后直接复用.

**跟 BE-14 关系**: 不冲突. 1 ticket 1 subagent 串行仍是 baseline. 这 4 字段是 ticket-level metadata, 不改变派单模式.

**跟 EPIC-054-A 关系**: 不冲突. worktree 隔离仍是 N ticket = N worktree. 这 4 字段加在 ticket.json 里, worktree 路径不变.

**历史 ticket 处理**: 仅新 ticket 强制. 历史 EPIC-001~EPIC-156 ticket 跳过 (留空 = legacy-no-binding).
acceptance: AC1: ticket.json schema 加 suggested_expert/actual_expert/expert_binding_at/binding_change_reason 4 字段, 向后兼容 (字段均可选, 旧 ticket 不破)
AC2: validator: suggested_expert 在枚举内 (4 default + 5 extended + 15 local), actual_expert 必填, change_reason 仅当 actual != suggested 时必填
AC3: /kallax-claim 读 suggested_expert → 写 actual_expert + expert_binding_at (ISO8601). Performer 改 actual 时提示写 binding_change_reason
AC4: /kallax-submit-pr 校验 actual_expert 必填, 若跟 suggested 不同必填 binding_change_reason 非空
AC5: sprint-metrics.sh mis_dispatch_rate 读 ticket.json, 输出 <10% PASS / ≥10% FAIL. 历史 ticket (无 suggested_expert) 跳过不计入分母
AC6: phase-review 输出 binding_consistency_report: 一致率 + 偏离列表 + change_reason 文本聚合
AC7: tests/integration/expert-binding-tracking.test.sh ≥6 case PASS (suggested=actual, 偏离带 reason, 偏离无 reason FAIL, 历史 ticket 跳过, 提交时校验, validator 枚举校验)
AC8: vitest sentinel tests PASS (npm run build exit 0, vitest exit 0)
AC9: 5-Level Verify L1-L5 PASS (scan-dead-code=0, build=0, cargo test=0, sentinel=0, check-claim-evidence=0)
AC10: 历史 ticket 不破 (load 旧 ticket.json 跳过校验, 不报错)
AC11: docs/reference/slash-commands.md 加 --claim 跟 --submit-pr 行为说明 + binding 字段表
AC12: CLAUDE.md 加 EPIC-157 引用 (跟 Rule 34 + EPIC-023-C 联合, 0 增 Rule)
